notes.title: Way of the Samurai 4 V1.04 - FOV & DOF options added to ini
notes.content:
Hi everyone.

We're just about to upload a new build which in addition to fixing a few bugs also adds Field of View, depth of field and bloom/glare options to the ini file.

Fixed - Camera sometimes spinning when changing scenes

Added new options to the .ini file (run the game first to update the ini file)

FOV - changes FieldOfView in-game (excludes cut scenes)
EnableDOF - set this value to 0 to disable depth of field effect
EnableHDR - set this value to 0 to disable bloom/glare effect

Audio volume fix – Audio between ingame voices and cut scenes should be the same.

Fixed issue with cursor displaying after saving the game

tags.bug: Fixed - Camera sometimes spinning when changing scenes

tags.feature: Added new options to the .ini file (run the game first to update the ini file)

tags.bug: Audio volume fix – Audio between ingame voices and cut scenes should be the same.
Fixed issue with cursor displaying after saving the game

notes.title: Way of the Samurai 4 V1.03
notes.content:
We’ve just uploaded another new build to Steam.

This one contains the following changes:

Fixed crash in curio shop
Added Swing barrels to the right mouse button
Settings are now saved to the ini file before mode change
Potential run time library fix

notes.title: Way of the Samurai 4 V1.01
notes.content:
Hi everyone.

We've just uploaded a new patch to steam.  This one contains the following fixes:

Fixed black screens upon death or loading a save that affected certain character types.
Fixed miscellaneous crashes
Fixed some audio issues

We had mouse support in but we were unable to get it working quite right. Expect a build early next week adding it in.

tags.bug: Fixed black screens upon death or loading a save that affected certain character types.

tags.feature: Expect a build early next week adding it in.
